eq-ch01-stage-combine: Each stage combines the saved step-start state, the current state and the stage increment with the integrator weights $w_0, w_1, w_2$.
eq-ch01-stage-weight: An increment supplied in stage $s$ enters the end-of-step state with weight $w_2^{(s)}$ times the $w_1$ of every later stage.
eq-ch01-stage-upwind: A tracer's transfer through an $x_1$ face is the clamped dry-mass transfer times the upwind cell's tracer ratio.
eq-ch01-stage-transfer: The tracer increment of a cell is the net face transfer divided by the cell volume, so internal faces cancel in the column sum.
eq-ch01-stage-dry: A supplied dry-mass source carries tracers at the selected carry ratio.
